incident.initial_inference: A stale CLOSE-WAIT provider socket and a non-growing trajectory were incorrectly interpreted as a provider request that had exceeded the 600 second request timeout.
incident.post_interruption_evidence: The KeyboardInterrupt traceback placed the main thread in terminal_server.handle -> executor.execute -> selector.select while executing a container shell command.
incident.interrupted_command: cd /data/project && export PIP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=1000 && export PIP_RETRIES=20 && timeout 3000 pip install --timeout 1000 --retries 20 -e . 2>&1 | tail -40
incident.conclusion: The original episode cannot be classified as an Agent failure, infrastructure timeout, or valid non-submission. It is excluded from every effectiveness and resource comparison.

replacement.decision_rule: Run one fresh replacement control because the invalidity was caused by operator intervention, not by the method outcome.

analysis_rule: Use replacement1 as the Meerkat A observation only if its manifest confirms the specified clean committed source and it reaches a protocol-valid terminal outcome. Preserve the original episode solely as incident evidence.
